## How it was tested

- [ ] `make lint` passes
- [ ] `make test` passes (in a throwaway container or VM: it needs root and creates a test user)
- [ ] Tried on a Bazzite PC, if it changes a check, fix or window (image and version: )

## Checklist

- [ ] Nothing changes on the PC without the person's confirmation, and every new fix can be undone
- [ ] New or changed fixes are checked again after they run
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under `[Unreleased]`
- [ ] Screenshots are attached for visible changes, with no personal details in them
